verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own pages describe IP litigation across all three areas. They cite a national patent litigation practice representing both patent holders and alleged infringers, over 3,500 active trademark disputes, and trade-secret misappropriation litigation. The only outcome-type evidence is an aggregate Patexia ranking; no specific courts, venues, or case results are described. Missing for 10: named courts or venues (e.g., district courts, ITC, PTAB, TTAB), specific case outcomes or verdicts, and independent corroboration.
